title: Prefix and Aspect 2: When the Prefix Adds Meaning Too
titleRussian: Приставка и вид 2: Когда приставка добавляет и значение
description: A pure prefix only perfectivizes (писать → написать). Most prefixes perfectivize AND add a meaning shade (писать → переписать 'rewrite', дописать 'finish writing'). Both kinds make the verb perfective; the difference is whether the meaning changes.
descriptionRussian: Чисто видовая приставка только делает глагол совершенным (писать → написать). Большинство приставок делают глагол совершенным И добавляют оттенок значения (писать → переписать, дописать). Оба типа дают совершенный вид; разница в том, меняется ли значение.
intro: Not every prefix behaves the same way. Some only change the aspect and leave the meaning alone; most change both. The test is simple and mechanical: compare the prefixed verb with the bare one. Same meaning means the prefix was doing only grammatical work. Different meaning means it was doing both, and that changes what its imperfective partner will be.
rules: A pure prefix perfectivizes without changing meaning: писать → написать (both 'to write'). The imperfective partner stays the simplex: писать.
Most prefixes perfectivize AND add a meaning shade: писать → переписать (rewrite), дописать (finish writing), записать (write down), подписать (sign). Every one is perfective.
To tell them apart, compare the prefixed verb's meaning to the simplex. Same meaning = pure prefix. Different meaning = the prefix added a shade.
A meaning-adding prefix cannot take the simplex as its imperfective. переписать (rewrite) does not pair with писать; it needs a new imperfective, переписывать (the secondary imperfective, Lesson 3).
The same prefix can be pure on one verb and meaningful on another. Judge each verb by comparing it to its simplex, not by the prefix alone.
examples: писать → написать (write). Pure prefix на-: same meaning, perfective. Pair: писать / написать.
писать → переписать (rewrite). Пере- adds 'redo': different meaning, perfective. Needs a new impf: переписывать.
писать → дописать (finish writing). До- adds 'reach the end': different meaning. New impf: дописывать.
читать → прочитать (read through). Про- is close to pure here. Pair: читать / прочитать.
читать → перечитать (reread). Пере- adds 'again': different meaning. New impf: перечитывать.
делать → сделать (do). Pure prefix с-. But делать → переделать (redo) adds meaning, new impf переделывать.

tables.title: One root, many perfectives: pure vs meaning-adding prefix

items.prompt: В паре писать / написать приставка на-…
items.promptEnglish: In the pair писать / написать, the prefix на-…
items.hint: Do писать and написать mean different things, or the same thing?
items.explanation: Писать and написать both mean 'to write,' so на- here is a pure perfectivizing prefix: it only changes the aspect, not the meaning. A prefix that changed the meaning (like пере- in переписать) would be a meaning-adding prefix.

items.prompt: Учительница попросила меня _____ работу аккуратнее, потому что было много ошибок.
items.promptEnglish: The teacher asked me to rewrite the work more neatly because there were many mistakes.
items.hint: Many mistakes → do it over again. Which prefix carries 'redo'?
items.explanation: 'Because there were many mistakes' signals doing the work over again. The prefix пере- adds the shade 'redo': переписать (rewrite). Написать is the plain perfective 'write'; дописать is 'finish writing'; подписать is 'sign.'

items.prompt: Я почти закончил, осталось только _____ последний абзац.
items.promptEnglish: I am almost finished; I just need to finish writing the last paragraph.
items.hint: The work is in progress and needs to reach its end. Which prefix means 'reach the end'?
items.explanation: 'Almost finished, just the last paragraph' is about reaching the endpoint of work already in progress. The prefix до- adds 'reach the end': дописать (finish writing). Переписать would mean redo it; записать means write down; подписать means sign.

items.prompt: Перед уходом не забудь _____ договор внизу страницы.
items.promptEnglish: Before you leave, don't forget to sign the contract at the bottom of the page.
items.hint: 'At the bottom of the page' = put your name beneath. Which prefix means 'add beneath'?
items.explanation: 'At the bottom of the page' points to signing. The prefix под- adds the shade 'add beneath': подписать (to sign). The other options all involve writing the text itself, not signing it.

items.prompt: Антон быстро _____ адрес в телефон, чтобы не забыть.
items.promptEnglish: Anton quickly wrote the address down in his phone so as not to forget.
items.hint: 'So as not to forget' = note it, fix it in place. Which prefix means 'fix in place'?
items.explanation: 'So as not to forget' signals noting something down. The prefix за- adds the shade 'fix in place': записать (write down). Переписал is rewrite, дописал is finish writing, подписал is sign.

options: значит то же самое, только совершенный вид
добавляет значение «сделать заново» и совершенный вид
items.answer: добавляет значение «сделать заново» и совершенный вид
items.hint: Does переделать mean the same as делать, or 'do over again'?
items.explanation: Переделать means 'redo, do over again,' which is different from plain делать. So пере- here is a meaning-adding prefix: it perfectivizes AND adds the shade 'redo.' Because the meaning changed, переделать will need a secondary imperfective (переделывать), not делать.

blanks: Сочинение было слабое, и мне пришлось _____ его полностью. (The essay was weak, and I had to rewrite it completely.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: 'Rewrite it completely' because the essay was weak points to redoing the work. The prefix пере- adds the shade 'redo': переписать. Because the meaning differs from plain писать, the imperfective partner of переписать is the secondary imperfective переписывать, not писать.

errorCorrection.sentence: Чтобы не забыть, Лена подписала адрес в блокнот.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: So as not to forget, Lena wrote the address down in her notebook.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Чтобы не забыть ...В блокнот' (so as not to forget, in a notebook) signals noting something down, the за- shade (fix in place): записала. Подписала means 'signed' (added a signature beneath), which makes no sense for an address in a notebook. Переписала means 'rewrote / copied out', дописала 'finished writing'. All are perfective; the prefix decides the meaning.

errorCorrection.sentence: Директор внимательно прочитал договор и записал его внизу.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: The director carefully read the contract and signed it at the bottom.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Договор ...Внизу' (the contract ...At the bottom) signals adding a signature, the под- shade (add beneath): подписал. Записал means 'wrote down / noted' (a separate act), переписал 'rewrote', дописал 'finished writing'. You sign (подписать) a contract at the bottom; you do not 'write it down'. The prefix carries the meaning; all four are perfective.

errorCorrection.sentence: Игорь сел за стол и переписал длинное письмо своей бабушке.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Igor sat down at the table and wrote a long letter to his grandmother.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Сел за стол и ...' (sat down and ...) frames writing a fresh letter for the first time, the plain perfective with the pure prefix на-: написал. Переписал means 'rewrote / copied out', which wrongly implies an earlier version; дописал means 'finished writing something in progress', записал 'wrote down / noted'. Here на- is the pure perfectivizing prefix: написать means simply 'to write', the same as писать but perfective.

minimalPairs.context: В тексте были ошибки, поэтому я его _____.
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: There were mistakes in the text, so I rewrote it.
minimalPairs.explanation: 'There were mistakes, so…' signals doing the text over again, which is the пере- shade: переписал (rewrote). Написал would simply mean 'wrote it' for the first time, which the 'there were mistakes' context rules out. Both are perfective; the prefix decides the meaning.

minimalPairs.context: Урок почти закончен, мне осталось _____ вывод.
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The lesson is almost done; I just have to finish writing the conclusion.
minimalPairs.explanation: 'Almost done, just the conclusion left' is about reaching the endpoint, which is the до- shade: дописать (finish writing). Переписать would mean rewriting the whole thing, which the 'almost done' context contradicts.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort each perfective verb by what its prefix does: pure (only aspect, same meaning as the simplex) or meaning-adding (aspect plus a new shade).

reviewVocab.definition: shade of meaning added by a prefix (пере- = redo/across, до- = finish, за- = fix in place, под- = add beneath)
reviewVocab.example: Приставки дают оттенки значения: написать (просто «писать»), но переписать — «писать заново».

reviewVocab.definition: to rewrite, copy out (pf переписать, secondary impf переписывать); пере- adds 'redo' and perfectivizes
reviewVocab.example: Я переписал письмо (готово) — я переписываю письмо (процесс).

reviewVocab.definition: to finish writing (pf дописать, secondary impf дописывать); до- adds 'reach the end'
